title: LayoutState
description: UI layout state contract for persisting window/panel arrangements. Version 1.1 adds splitter ratio support.

version.description: Layout state schema version (1.1 = ratio support)

regions.description: Window regions with their panel states

region.description: Region identifier (e.g., left, center, right, bottom)

activePanelId.description: Currently active panel in this region

openedPanels.description: List of opened panel IDs in this region

widthRatio.description: Optional normalized width ratio (0-1) for left/center/right columns

heightRatio.description: Optional normalized height ratio (0-1) for top/bottom rows
